subject: Engagement stack usage audit and renewal alignment with Outreach
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Engagement stack usage audit and renewal alignment

Sam —

We’re approaching our Outreach renewal window (Dec 15) and I want to align on actual seat usage and a pragmatic renewal path. Attached is a usage export for Q3–Q4 (redwood_usage_report_q3.csv). High-level asks: 

- Can you confirm active seat vs paid seat counts for 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-15?
- Provide an apples-to-apples renewal quote that reflects a right-sized seat count and an annual vs. 12-month term comparison.
- Any programmatic discounts for reserved seats or committed CS collaboration credits we should consider?

We’ve looped Ben (finance) and Marissa (Ops) — if Outreach can produce a draft quote + redlines by EOD Friday (11/19) we’ll route to legal and finance the following week.

Thanks — note we need a clear path that doesn’t increase per-seat unit cost while removing idle licenses.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_usage_report_q3.csv (CSV)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@outreach.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@outreach.io>
Date: 2026-11-18T12:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack usage audit and renewal alignment

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the export and the clear asks. Quick summary from our side based on the file you sent:

- Active seats observed (10/1–11/15): 220 distinct users with >1 event in period.
- Current billed seats on your account: 270 seats.
- Monthly average MAU ratio: ~81% (we see pockets of teams with low utilization).

I attached a draft renewal quote (draft_quote_outreach_v1.pdf) that shows: baseline 12-month renewal for 240 seats, with an option for 12-month commitment at 235 seats with a 7% discount and an annual payment option for additional 3% credit. There’s also a 6-month seasonal burst addendum that can be toggled.

We can do a quick call Thursday morning to walk through the assumptions — otherwise I’ll push a version with our standard redlines to Contracts for review by EOD.

Cheers,
Sam Turner
Strategic Accounts — Outreach
attachments: draft_quote_outreach_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Engagement stack usage audit and renewal alignment

Looping legal and finance next — quick internal notes before we engage Contracts: 

- Budget ceiling for Outreach renewals this cycle is $315k ARR net (we can flex ~10% if we get multi-year).
- Priority 1: remove 15–25% of persistent idle seats without incurring a higher unit price.
- Priority 2: preserve burst capacity for Q1 product launches (we may accept a small overage buffer).

We should ask Outreach for an editable quote and a tracked redline doc. @Marissa — please flag any operational blockers if we reduce seat count on Dec 1 (onboarding, SSO provisioning, license reassignment windows).

Thanks — I’ll wait for Sam’s redlines and then we’ll send a single doc to legal for markup.

Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@outreach.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack usage audit and renewal alignment — agreed path

Sam / Contracts team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. After internal review we’re prepared to move forward on a 12-month renewal with the following agreed items: 

1) Seat count: 240 paid seats (right-sized from 270) effective 2027-01-01. We will perform a seat true-up at 6 months; any overage will be billed at the agreed per-seat rate.
2) Pricing: apply the 7% committed-seat discount you quoted (235+ commit level), and Redwood will elect annual payment to capture the additional 3% payment discount.
3) Burst capacity: include seasonal burst addendum allowing +15% for up to 60 days in Q1 without penalty; any sustained increase converts to billed seats after the burst window.
4) Contract mechanics: Sam please send an editable quote and tracked redlines. Contracts team — please send a redlines-ready version of the Outreach T&Cs so our legal can route.

Attachments we will send to legal: draft_redlines_v2.docx (our initial redlines), redwood_usage_report_q3.csv (supporting data).

Next steps: Sam to provide editable quote + Contracts contact; Redwood legal to return redlines by 11/24. Finance will prep PO paperwork once redlines are agreed.

If there are obstacles to the timeline (PO submission week of 11/29) flag them now. Otherwise let’s treat this as the alignment we’ll execute against.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: draft_redlines_v2.docx (DOCX), redwood_usage_report_q3.csv (CSV)
